issue.title: Archive Today-banner expand intermittently fails to repaint its agent row
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1kx.1 note #1. Full CI 38530013190, Python 3.13, timed out after l reopened the Today banner waiting for u.m@t00. The phase reports 20/20 serial passes and three green pytest -n 8 runs of the file. No duplicate found in task search or last-week sweep; no active epic establishes a causal owner. Investigate request coalescing between _request_if_needed, runtime.requested, and stale assembled snapshots after expand. Do not raise timeouts or loosen assertions. Read the new timeout diagnostics in tests/ace/tui/test_agent_archive_column_app.py.

task_type_fields.evidence: Phase sase-1kx.1 observed a CI failure in run 38530013190, then 20/20 serial passes and 3 green parallel file runs without an archive behavior fix. Failure rate in CI is unquantified; no serial reproduction. Hypothesis: dropped/coalesced post-expand window request.

issue.creation_reason: The release gate phase timeboxed this pre-existing archive race and requested a follow-up; its diagnostic change did not reproduce or fix the race.
